Axiom: Module decomposition accepts exactly two `product` / `library` scope states: - **operator-approved review-state draft** — the spec has a valid `CHANGE_MANIFEST`, and the current `sdd-state` `[SESSION]` working set contains the exact entry ` — module-decomposition handoff — operator-approved review-state draft`, written by the scope flow only after its final Approval Check; - **master** — the spec has no `CHANGE_MANIFEST`, and its exact `[SCOPES]` row's `status` column is `done`. A review-state draft without that exact session entry is unapproved and must not enter the module flow; a bare `approved` label is not an alias for either state. Infrastructure remains the sole no-module scope type. The scope draft is not independently critic-reviewed: integrated review starts only after the module bundle exists.
